name: Profit Margin
description: Calculate profit margin as a percentage of revenue.
business_contexts: a retailer assessing profit margin across total revenue and cost
a manufacturer assessing profit margin on a product line
a service firm assessing profit margin on a book of business
an e-commerce brand assessing profit margin across a season
a software company assessing profit margin on total bookings
question_patterns: Given the revenue and cost below, what is the profit margin?
Calculate the profit margin from the figures given.
What percentage of revenue is profit, given the values below?
Calculate profit margin as a percentage of revenue from the figures shown.
Using the revenue and cost given, what is the profit margin?
solution_logic: Step 1: Calculate profit margin = (revenue − cost) / revenue
key_insight: Profit margin is the same calculation as profit divided by revenue — profit is just revenue minus cost, so the margin is that gap expressed as a share of revenue.
common_mistakes: Dividing by cost instead of revenue
Reporting the dollar profit instead of converting it to a percentage of revenue
framework_soundbite: Profit margin is profit over revenue — the gap expressed as a share of the top line.
